result.detail: Neo4j Aura API uses per-customer OAuth2 client credentials. Each customer creates own in Aura console, tied to their user account. No vendor review, approval, listing, or install/user cap on that page. neo4j.com/docs/api/ gave 404, so answer rests on the Aura API auth page. Absence on one page, not proof no policy exists elsewhere.
result.quote: All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
